title: Arsenal v Everton: a closer scoring comparison than the unbeaten head-to-head suggests
description: Arsenal–Everton, 24 October 2026: actual goals, xG, shots on target, direct meetings and a transparent model baseline.

sections.heading: Why this game is worth watching
paragraphs: Arsenal have not lost to Everton across their last five league meetings: three wins and two draws. Yet their current goals-per-match rates are not miles apart, so this match is about whether Arsenal’s defensive edge holds against an Everton side that can create chances.

sections.heading: Current team strength, with sample sizes
paragraphs: In the accessible Premier League snapshot Arsenal had 8 goals for and 4 against in 5 games (1.60 and 0.80 per match), 8.48 xG and 24 shots on target. Everton had 8 goals for, 5 against in 6 games (1.33 and 0.83 per match), 9.00 xG and 30 shots on target. All comparative bars are per-match; the samples have different denominators.

sections.heading: Recent results and head-to-head
paragraphs: Arsenal’s latest five *verified* completed league games were Aston Villa 0–1, Chelsea 2–1, Sunderland 0–2, Brighton 3–0 and Leeds 2–1 (3W–2L). Everton lost 0–2 to Chelsea on 17 October; its complete latest five-game sequence is not verified here. In five prior head-to-head games Arsenal recorded 3W–2D.

sections.heading: Forecast: transparent but uncertain
paragraphs: An independent Poisson reference combines Arsenal’s goals per game with Everton’s goals conceded per game, and vice versa. This uncalibrated baseline excludes injury news, starting lineups, home advantage and Arsenal’s 18 October fixture. It is not a reliable match probability or betting advice.
bullets: Uncalibrated Poisson: λhome 1.217, λaway 1.067; GF/GA per-match only
